     ORDER GRANTING SOUTHWESTERN PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANY’S
 EXPEDITED MOTION TO EXTEND DEADLINE TO FILE REBUTTAL TESTIMONY
            IN SUPPORT OF COMPREHENSIVE STIPULATION

        THIS MATTER comes before Patrick Schaefer and Keven Gedko, hearing examiners for

the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“Commission”), upon the Expedited Motion to

Extend the Deadline for any Party Filing Rebuttal Testimony in Support of the Comprehensive

Stipulation (“Motion to Extend Deadline”), filed by Southwestern Public Service Company

(“SPS”) on July 8, 2026.

        Being duly informed, the Hearing Examiners FIND and CONCLUDE as follows:

        1.     On June 18, 2026, the Hearing Examiners issued an Order Revising Procedural

Deadlines (the “Revised Procedural Order”).

        2.     The Revised Procedural Order established deadlines for testimony regarding the

Comprehensive Stipulation filed in this proceeding by SPS, the New Mexico Department of Justice

(“NMDOJ”), New Mexico Large Customer Group (“NMLCG”), Occidental Permian Ltd.

(“OPL”), Louisiana Energy Services LLC (“LES”), Walmart, Inc. (“Walmart”), Federal Executive

Agencies (“FEA”), Targa Resources Corp. (“Targa”), Coalition for Clean Affordable Energy

(“CCAE”), and Prosperity Works (the “Stipulation”). The Revised Procedural Order set the

deadline for Staff to file testimony in opposition to the Stipulation for July 7, 2026, before 12:00

p.m. MT, and set the deadline to file rebuttal testimony in support of the Stipulation for July 9,

2026.
                  BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
Order Granting SPS Motion to Extend Deadline                 Docket No. 25-00079-UT


       3.      Staff filed testimony in opposition to the Stipulation from five witnesses on July 7,

2026. Staff filed testimony from two witness before the 12:00 p.m. MT deadline established in the

Revised Procedural Order. At the same time, three of Staff’s witnesses filed testimony after the

deadline. One witness’ testimony was filed at 1:00 p.m, another was filed at 1:36 p.m., and the last

was filed at approximately 3:18 p.m. MT.

       4.      On July 8, 2026, SPS filed the present Motion to Extend Deadline, citing

1.2.2.12(A) NMAC, requesting the extension of the deadline for any party filing rebuttal testimony

in support of the comprehensive stipulation in this case from July 9, 2026, to July 10, 2026, at

12:00 p.m. MT.

       5.      In support of this Motion, SPS argues that due to the scope of Staff’s testimony and

the extremely short time between Staff’s filing and the current July 9, 2026 close of business

rebuttal deadline, SPS requests a short extension of the rebuttal deadline until July 10, 2026, at

12:00 p.m. MT. SPS also requests that the extension apply to any party filing rebuttal testimony in

support of the Stipulation. SPS also states that, of the parties it was able to contact, none oppose

the Motion to Extend Deadline.

       6.      Upon reviewing the request, the Hearing Examiners determine that, due to the late

filings from Staff witnesses, the brevity of the extension requested, its lack of impact on the hearing

on the Stipulation, and the absence of any expressed opposition, good cause exists to grant the

Motion to Extend.

       IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       A.      SPS’s Motion to extend deadline is GRANTED.

       B.      The deadline for any party filing rebuttal testimony in support of the stipulation is

extended to July 10, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. MT.
